sections.title: Independent Study
sections.description: An opportunity for the student to apply the theoretical ideas and tools learned from other courses through self study of a particular topic supervised by a sponsoring facutly member. To request approval for an independent study course, the student must submit a detailed proposal, signed by the supervising professor, the student's assigned Faculty Advisor, and departmental Undergraduate Chair, to the Office of Academic Programs two weeks prior to the start of the term. Prerequisite: Permission via application process
